description: Reference transcripts for the synthetic (TTS) speech fixtures. Each reference is the exact text given to the synthesizer in generate.sh (reference-label method: tts-input-text). Synthetic speech: no person's voice.
license: CMU Flite voices (BSD-style); texts authored for CE
scoring: WER/CER after normalize(): lowercase, punctuation removed except word-internal apostrophes, whitespace collapsed. A case/punctuation-sensitive WER is computed on whitespace tokens of the raw text.
